plugins.name: 42crunch-api-security-testing
plugins.descriptionZh: 使用 42Crunch 在 Claude Code 中直接实现 API 安全自动化——自动审计 OpenAPI 规范，检测与 OWASP API 安全风险（包括 BOLA/BFLA）对齐的漏洞，并应用 AI 驱动的修复。专为 AI 辅助开发工作流设计，通过审计->扫描->修复->验证循环提供持续防护，确保 API 在部署前满足企业安全标准。
plugins.descriptionEn: Automate API security directly in Claude Code with 42Crunch - automatically audit OpenAPI specs, detect vulnerabilities aligned with OWASP API Security risks (including BOLA/BFLA), and apply AI-powered fixes. Designed for AI-assisted development workflows, it provides continuous guardrails through an audit->scan->remediate->validate loop, ensuring APIs meet enterprise security standards before deployment.
plugins.author: 42Crunch

plugins.name: adobe-for-creativity

plugins.descriptionEn: Harness Adobe's creative AI-powered tools to edit images, automate design workflows, and bring creative visions to life — from background removal to vectorization and professional retouching.
plugins.author: Adobe

plugins.name: airtable
plugins.descriptionZh: Airtable 是为你的代理提供支持的数据库和运营层——无论你是在运营产品、营销、销售、运营、HR 还是自定义业务应用。它将结构化数据与人类和代理共享的多人可视化界面（网格、看板、日历、画廊、时间线）相结合——并支持与 Jira、Salesforce、Zendesk、Google Drive、Databricks 以及技术栈中其他工具的同步集成，一切均由企业级治理提供支持。此插件让 Claude 精通 Airtable：创建基表和架构、处理记录，以及共享 UI 以进行协作。内置官方 Airtable MCP 服务器。
plugins.descriptionEn: Airtable is the database and operations layer for your agents — whether running product, marketing, sales, ops, HR, or a custom business app. It combines structured data with multiplayer visual surfaces (grid, kanban, calendar, gallery, timeline) humans and agents share — plus sync integrations to Jira, Salesforce, Zendesk, Google Drive, Databricks, and the rest of your stack, all backed by enterprise governance. This plugin makes Claude fluent in Airtable: creating bases and schema, working with records, and sharing UI for collaboration. Bundles the official Airtable MCP server.
plugins.author: Airtable

plugins.name: airwallex-agentos
plugins.descriptionZh: 将 Airwallex 的全球金融基础设施接入 Claude。用自然语言编排账户中的各类操作，例如根据 PO 生成发票、从发票中完成供应商入驻、查询各币种的当前现金头寸。AgentOS 将预置的财务 Skills 与 MCP 服务器打包在一起。公共 CLI 可将你的 agent 连接到 Airwallex 的各项能力。
plugins.descriptionEn: Bring Airwallex's global financial infrastructure to Claude. Orchestrate actions across your account in plain language, e.g., set up invoices from a PO, onboard suppliers from invoices, and check current cash position across currencies. AgentOS bundles pre-built finance Skills with MCP servers. A public CLI connects your agent to Airwallex's capabilities.
plugins.author: Airwallex

plugins.name: airwallex-dev
plugins.descriptionZh: 在你自己的代码库中构建 Airwallex 支付集成。为 Airwallex 集成生成结账、卡元素、入驻和订阅计费的代码，并接入你的项目：Hosted Payment Page、Drop-in 与 Split Card 元素、关联账户 KYC 入驻，以及用于订阅和卡保存的 Billing Hosted Checkout。还可为 AI 服务商规划卡存档的商户发起交易流程，例如充值和自动续费。
plugins.descriptionEn: Build Airwallex payment integrations in your own codebase. Generates the checkout, card-element, onboarding, and subscription-billing code for an Airwallex integration and wires it into your project: Hosted Payment Page, Drop-in and Split Card elements, connected-account KYC onboarding, and Billing Hosted Checkout for subscriptions and card-saving. Also plans card-on-file merchant-initiated flows for AI providers such as top-ups and auto-recharge.
plugins.author: Airwallex

plugins.name: atlassian-twg-cli
plugins.descriptionZh: Teamwork Graph CLI 是 Atlassian 面向 agent 的接口，连接你的全部工作上下文：Jira issue、Confluence 页面、Bitbucket PR，以及已接入的第三方数据源。专为 Claude Code（终端或桌面端）等编码 agent 打造，由 Atlassian 的上下文图谱驱动。试试："根据这个 PR 起草一个 Jira issue，并将其关联到 epic。" 在浏览器中使用 Claude Code？请改为安装 Atlassian Rovo MCP 插件。安装后运行 /twg-setup，即可将 Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI 连接到 Claude Code。
plugins.descriptionEn: Teamwork Graph CLI is Atlassian's agent-first interface to your entire work context: Jira issues, Confluence pages, Bitbucket PRs, along with your connected third-party data sources. Purpose-built for coding agents like Claude Code (terminal or desktop), and powered by Atlassian's context graph. Try: "draft a Jira issue from this PR and link it to the epic." Using Claude Code in the browser? Install the Atlassian Rovo MCP plugin instead. Run /twg-setup after install to connect Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI to Claude Code.
plugins.author: Atlassian

plugins.name: atomic-agents

plugins.descriptionEn: Comprehensive development workflow for building AI agents with the Atomic Agents framework. Includes specialized agents for schema design, architecture planning, code review, and tool development. Features guided workflows, progressive-disclosure skills, and best practice validation.

plugins.name: aws-startup-advisor
plugins.descriptionZh: 基于 350,000+ 家初创公司的实践模式打造的个性化 AWS 指导。获取与你的发展阶段相匹配的架构、成本和安全建议，从第一天创建账户到生产就绪的基础设施全程覆盖。从 Azure、GCP 或 Heroku 迁移到 AWS，提供资源发现、成本估算和生成的 Terraform。将 OpenAI、Azure OpenAI 和 Gemini 代码迁移到 Amazon Bedrock，并在 AgentCore 及其他 AWS 运行时上规划和构建 AI agent 原型。包含 AWS Activate 抵用金资格、60+ 项初创公司专属优惠，以及多账户、多区域支持。由 AWS 初创公司解决方案架构师构建。
plugins.descriptionEn: Personalized AWS guidance built on patterns from 350,000+ startups. Get architecture, cost, and security recommendations matched to your stage, from day-one account setup to production-ready infrastructure. Migrate to AWS from Azure, GCP, or Heroku with resource discovery, cost estimates, and generated Terraform. Move OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and Gemini code to Amazon Bedrock, and plan and prototype AI agents on AgentCore and other AWS runtimes. Includes AWS Activate credits eligibility, 60+ exclusive startup offers, and multi-account, multi-region support. Built by AWS Startup Solutions Architects.
plugins.author: Amazon Web Services

plugins.name: aws-transform
plugins.descriptionZh: 将代码库迁移、现代化并升级到 AWS。可将 .NET Framework 转换为 .NET 8/10，将大型机 COBOL 转换为 Java，将 VMware 虚拟机迁移到 EC2，将 SQL Server 迁移到 Aurora，并升级 Java/Python/Node.js 版本和 AWS SDK。AWS Transform - continuous modernization 会分析代码库中的技术债务、安全问题和升级机会，并进行修复。
plugins.descriptionEn: Migrate, modernize, and upgrade codebases to AWS. Transforms .NET Framework to .NET 8/10, mainframe COBOL to Java, VMware VMs to EC2, SQL Server to Aurora, and upgrades Java/Python/Node.js versions and AWS SDKs. AWS Transform - continuous modernization analyzes codebases for tech debt, security issues, and upgrade opportunities, then remediates them.
plugins.author: Amazon Web Services

It enables Claude to perform real-world tasks: listing resources, validating deployments, diagnosing infrastructure issues, and optimizing costs across 50+ Azure services.

plugins.descriptionZh: 直接在 Claude Code 中部署、管理和监控你的 Hostinger 服务。该 plugin 将 Claude 连接到 Hostinger 的远程 MCP server，让你无需离开编码环境即可发布网站和应用、管理域名和 DNS、运行 WordPress 以及运维 VPS 服务器。你的机器上无需安装任何东西：不需要 Node.js，不需要 npm，也不需要本地服务器。主要功能包括：一条 prompt 即可部署静态站点、Node.js 应用（基于 Hostinger 构建）、完整的 WordPress 站点导入，以及 WordPress 插件和主题，此外还支持 Agency Plan 上的静态站点和 PHP 站点。除部署外，Claude 还可以搜索和注册域名、编辑 DNS 记录与快照、查看构建日志，以及管理邮箱、在线商店、电子邮件营销联系人、订阅和订单。它还能控制 VPS 防火墙、快照和监控。首次使用时通过浏览器登录（OAuth），或从 hPanel 设置 `HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN`。使用方法：无需记住任何命令。描述你的需求，Claude 会选择正确的工具或部署 skill。试试“deploy my static site to Hostinger”、“deploy this Next.js app to example.com”、“create an A record pointing example.com to 1.2.3.4”，或“show VPS metrics for the last 24 hours”。
plugins.descriptionEn: Deploy, manage and monitor your Hostinger services directly from Claude Code. The plugin connects Claude to Hostinger's remote MCP server, so you can ship sites and apps, manage domains and DNS, run WordPress and operate VPS servers without leaving your coding environment. There's nothing to install on your machine: no Node.js, no npm, no local server. Key features include one-prompt deployments for static sites, Node.js apps (built on Hostinger), full WordPress site imports, and WordPress plugins and themes, plus static and PHP sites on the Agency Plan. Beyond deployments, Claude can search and register domains, edit DNS records and snapshots, check build logs, and manage mailboxes, online stores, email marketing contacts, subscriptions and orders. It can also control VPS firewalls, snapshots and monitoring. Sign in through your browser (OAuth) on first use, or set a `HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN` from hPanel. How to use: there are no commands to memorize. Describe what you want and Claude picks the right tool or deployment skill. Try "deploy my static site to Hostinger", "deploy this Next.js app to example.com", "create an A record pointing example.com to 1.2.3.4", or "show VPS metrics for the last 24 hours."
